title: Applicability.
bodyText: This article applies only to a support proceeding under the Convention. In such a proceeding, if a provision of this article is inconsistent with Articles 1 through 6, this article controls.
bodyHtml: §576B-702  Applicability.  This article applies only to a support proceeding under the Convention.  In such a proceeding, if a provision of this article is inconsistent with Articles 1 through 6, this article controls. [L 2015, c 77, pt of §1]
